Forsig

Back to developer console

Docs

Human approval in one API call.

Create an agent, create an API key, call Forsig when your AI agent reaches a risky action, and wait for a human decision. The normal loop is: your app creates an escalation, Forsig pauses the workflow, a human decides, and your app resumes with the returned instruction.

Real workflow checklist

  1. Create an agent in the developer console.
  2. Create an API key and copy it once.
  3. Call /api/v1/escalations from your app when an action needs review.
  4. Review the escalation in Inbox.
  5. Send a decision and have your app fetch or wait for the result.
  6. Verify the full trail in Audit trails.

Install

npm install @forsig/sdk

Escalate

import { Forsig } from "@forsig/sdk";

const forsig = new Forsig({
  apiKey: process.env.FORSIG_API_KEY,
  baseUrl: "https://www.forsig.com"
});

const decision = await forsig.escalate({
  agent: { id: "refund-agent", name: "Refund Agent", environment: "production" },
  risk: { type: "refund_over_limit", level: "high" },
  task: {
    title: "Approve refund for customer #123",
    proposedAction: "Issue a $500 refund",
    customerImpact: true
  },
  context: { refundAmount: 500, customerTier: "VIP" },
  waitForDecision: true
});

Raw API request

curl -X POST https://www.forsig.com/api/v1/escalations \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $FORSIG_API_KEY" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "agent": { "id": "refund-agent", "name": "Refund Agent", "environment": "production" },
    "risk": { "type": "refund_over_limit", "level": "high" },
    "task": {
      "title": "Approve refund for customer #123",
      "proposedAction": "Issue a $500 refund",
      "customerImpact": true
    },
    "context": { "refundAmount": 500, "customerTier": "VIP" },
    "review": { "notify": ["dashboard"] }
  }'

Test modes

Use the developer console button to create UI test escalations. Use auto_approve, auto_reject, or auto_timeout only when testing agent control flow automatically. For real manual review, omit testMode.

Fetch a decision

const result = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/v1/escalations/${escalation.id}`, {
  headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.FORSIG_API_KEY}` }
}).then((res) => res.json());

Decision webhooks

When callbackUrl is set, Forsig posts the resolved decision with x-forsig-event and x-forsig-signature headers.

Private beta safety

Send only the minimum context needed for review. Avoid secrets, credentials, unnecessary PII, and regulated data.
